en.title: Pickup Truck Export Procurement for Latin America: Classification, Load and Admission
en.seo_title: Pickup Truck Export to Latin America: Brazil, Peru and Argentina Classification Rules
en.meta_description: Match a pickup's cab, bed, engine and drivetrain build to Brazilian CAMINHONETE versus CAMIONETA classification, Peru's used-vehicle inspection gate and Argentina's LCM model licence before you accept a payload or towing figure.
en.summary: Pickups are marketed globally but classified nationally. Brazil distinguishes CAMINHONETE from CAMIONETA and limits cargo-vehicle occupants; Peru gates used pickups through a verifying-entity inspection; Argentina requires an LCM model licence. Badge-level towing and payload figures must be tied to the exact OEM derivative.
en.method: Document research and procurement analysis of official Brazilian (CTB/CONTRAN), Peruvian (SUNAT) and Argentine sources on classification and admission; international and regional materials are background only. Statements are bounded to Brazil, Peru and Argentina.
en.ai_disclosure: Prepared by the AutoBridge Export Editorial Team with AI assistance for source organization, drafting, revision and translation. This is AI-assisted independent review, not human editorial sign-off; final editorial review is pending.
en.evidence_boundary: No first-hand inspection, transaction, interview or ownership is claimed. Other Latin American markets' classification, licence and load rules, any tax outcome, and any OEM payload/towing figure for an offered build without the exact derivative page are not verified and must be confirmed before payment.

zh.title: 皮卡出口拉美采购：分类、载荷与准入
zh.seo_title: 皮卡出口拉美：巴西、秘鲁与阿根廷的分类规则
zh.meta_description: 把皮卡的驾驶室、货箱、发动机与驱动配置，对照巴西 CAMINHONETE 与 CAMIONETA 分类、秘鲁二手车检验关口与阿根廷 LCM 车型许可，再决定是否接受某个载重或拖挂数字。
zh.summary: 皮卡全球销售、各国分类。巴西区分 CAMINHONETE 与 CAMIONETA 并限制载货车辆乘员；秘鲁以核验机构检验作为二手皮卡准入关口；阿根廷要求 LCM 车型许可。铭牌级拖挂与载重数字必须绑定确切 OEM 衍生车型。
zh.method: 针对巴西（CTB/CONTRAN）、秘鲁（SUNAT）与阿根廷官方分类与准入来源做文献研究与采购分析，国际与区域材料仅作背景；表述限定于巴西、秘鲁与阿根廷。
zh.ai_disclosure: 由 AutoBridge Export Editorial Team 编写，AI 协助完成来源整理、起草、修订与翻译。这是 AI 辅助的独立审阅，并非人工编辑签发，最终编辑审阅仍在进行中。
zh.evidence_boundary: 本页不主张任何一手检测、交易、采访或持有经历。其他拉美市场的分类、驾照与载重规则、任何税务结果，以及缺少确切衍生车型页面时所售配置的任何 OEM 载重/拖挂数字均未核实，付款前须确认。
